english.title: Leave a disabled taxi longer than necessary on authorised standing / taxi feeder park on Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a disabled taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), left it on

(A)_[an authorised standing]_
(B)_[a taxi feeder park]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) in Heathrow Airport longer than was reasonably necessary to effect its removal
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9(5) and 2(3) of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
